days.title: Northern Peaks and Valleys
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Storberget
stops.detail: The north is dominated by a mountain range (the highest elevation is the 550-meter-high Storberget) with rock faces that drop off vertically in parts to the south.

stops.name: Björnberget
stops.detail: One reaches the national park, which is developed only in the eastern part via a hiking trail to the Björnberget viewpoint, by following the signs to the national park from Road 92 (Frederika – Åsele) (gravel road).

days.driving: Allow time between these sights; local travel times are not verified and conditions vary.

days.title: Eastern Lakes and Heritage Streams
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Angsjön
stops.detail: In a depression of this valley, around 200 meters below Storberget, lies Lake Angsjön in the east of the national park, which is followed by extensive bog areas.

stops.name: Angsjöbäcken
stops.detail: At Angsjöbäcken, remains of a timber floating wall and wooden floating barriers can be discovered.

stops.name: Svärmorsbäcken
stops.detail: Peat mowing was carried out to a small extent on the moor meadows at Svärmorsbäcken, Björkbäcken and Angsjön.
